name: account.exchange
title: Account:Exchange
description: The declaration to configure an Exchange account.

payloadkeys.title: Account name
payloadkeys.content: The name that apps show to the user for this Exchange account. If not present, the system generates a suitable default.

payloadkeys.title: Enabled protocol types
payloadkeys.content:
The set of protocol types to enable on the Exchange server, in order of preference. This is an array of unique strings with possible values:

- `EAS:` Exchange ActiveSync
- `EWS:` Exchange Web Services

If the device supports one or more of the listed protocol types, it sets up an account for the first supported type.

If the device doesn't support any of the listed protocol types, it doesn't set up an account and the system reports an error.

payloadkeys.title: User identity asset reference
payloadkeys.content: The identifier of an asset declaration that contains the user identity for this account. The corresponding asset must be of type `UserIdentity`.

payloadkeys.title: Server host name
payloadkeys.content: The IP address or fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the Exchange host.

payloadkeys.title: Server port
payloadkeys.content: The port number of the EWS server. The system uses this only when this declaration has a `HostName` value. Applicable for "EWS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Server path
payloadkeys.content: The path of the EWS server. The system uses this only when this declaration has a `HostName` value. Applicable for "EWS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Server external host name
payloadkeys.content: The external hostname of the EWS server (or IP address). Applicable for "EWS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Server external port
payloadkeys.content: The external port number of the EWS server. The system uses this only when this declaration has an `ExternalHostName` value. Applicable for "EWS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Server external path
payloadkeys.content: The external path of the EWS server. The system uses this only when this declaration has an `ExternalHostName` value. Applicable for "EWS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Controls use of OAuth
payloadkeys.content: The configuration settings for OAuth for this account.

subkeys.title: Use OAuth
subkeys.content: If `true`, enables OAuth for this account.

subkeys.title: Sign in URL
subkeys.content: The URL that this account uses for signing in with OAuth. The system ignores this value unless `Enabled` is `true`. The system doesn't use autodiscovery when a declaration contains this URL, so the declaration must also contain a `HostName`.

subkeys.title: Token request URL
subkeys.content: The URL that this account uses for token requests with OAuth. The system ignores this value unless `Enabled` is `true`. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Authentication credentials asset reference
payloadkeys.content: The identifier of an asset declaration that contains the credentials for this account to authenticate with an Exchange server. Set the corresponding asset type to `CredentialUserNameAndPassword`.

payloadkeys.title: Authentication identity asset reference
payloadkeys.content: The identifier of a credential asset declaration that contains the identity that this account requires to authenticate with the Exchange server.

payloadkeys.title: S/MIME settings
payloadkeys.content: Settings for S/MIME. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: S/MIME signing settings
subkeys.content: Settings for S/MIME signing. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Signing enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, the system enables S/MIME signing. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: S/MIME signing identity asset reference
subkeys.content: The identifier of an asset declaration containing the identity required for S/MIME signing of messages sent from this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Signing user overrideable
subkeys.content: If `true`, the user can turn S/MIME signing on or off in Settings. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Signing identity user overrideable
subkeys.content: If `true`, the user can select an S/MIME signing identity in Settings. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: S/MIME encryption settings
subkeys.content: Settings for S/MIME encryption. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Encryption by default enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, the system enables S/MIME encryption by default, which the user can't override if `PerMessageSwitchEnabled` is `false`. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: S/MIME encryption identity asset reference
subkeys.content: The identifier of an asset declaration containing the identity required for S/MIME encryption. The system attaches the public certificate to outgoing mail to allow the user to receive encrypted mail. When the user sends encrypted mail, the system uses the public certificate to encrypt the copy of the mail in their Sent mailbox. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Encryption by default user overrideable
subkeys.content: If `true`, the user can turn S/MIME encryption by default on or off in Settings. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Encryption identity user overrideable
subkeys.content: If `true`, the user can select an S/MIME signing identity in Settings. Applicable for "EAS" only.

subkeys.title: Per message switch enabled
subkeys.content: If `true`, the system enables the per-message encryption switch in the compose view. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Mail service active
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system activates the mail service for this account.

payloadkeys.title: Lock mail service
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system prevents the user from changing the status of the mail service for this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Contacts service active
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, activates the address book service for this account.

payloadkeys.title: Lock contacts service
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system prevents the user from changing the status of the address book service for this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Calendar service active
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, activates the calendar service for this account.

payloadkeys.title: Lock calendar service
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system prevents the user from changing the status of the calendar service for this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Reminders service active
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system activates the reminders service for this account.

payloadkeys.title: Lock reminders service
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system prevents the user from changing the status of the reminders service for this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.

payloadkeys.title: Notes service active
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system activates the notes service for this account.

payloadkeys.title: Lock notes service
payloadkeys.content: If `true`, the system prevents the user from changing the status of the notes service for this account. Applicable for "EAS" only.
